canonical.question: What different-day rebooking rule and valid-ticket change rule does the National Rail Anytime ticket guidance give?
canonical.expected_primary: If you choose to travel on a different day, not covered by your original ticket, there is no admin fee to get a refund and rebook your ticket.
canonical.expected_secondary: You can still change your reservation, class and/or route once your ticket has become valid for travel.
canonical.tampered_primary: If you choose to travel on a different day, you must pay a £25 rebooking fee.
